name: fix_admin_backend_role_assignment
query: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_self_profile_role_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ BEGIN IF auth.uid() = OLD.id AND NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Le rôle du profil ne peut pas être modifié par le titulaire du compte.'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_profile_role_assignment() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ DECLARE v_role_id uuid; BEGIN IF NEW.role IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT r.id INTO v_role_id FROM public.roles AS r WHERE r.name = NEW.role LIMIT 1; IF v_role_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rôle de profil inconnu.'; END IF; DELETE FROM public.user_roles AS ur WHERE ur.user_id = NEW.id AND ur.role_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM public.roles AS r WHERE r.name IN ('admin', 'student')); INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role_id) VALUES (NEW.id, v_role_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; RETURN NEW; END; $$; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS edutech_prevent_self_profile_role_change ON public.profiles; CREATE TRIGGER edutech_prevent_self_profile_role_change BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_self_profile_role_change(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS edutech_sync_profile_role_assignment ON public.profiles; CREATE TRIGGER edutech_sync_profile_role_assignment AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF role ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sync_profile_role_assignment(); INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT p.id, r.id FROM public.profiles AS p JOIN public.roles AS r ON r.name = p.role WHERE p.role IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.prevent_self_profile_role_change() FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.sync_profile_role_assignment() FROM PUBLIC;
